files..github/copilot-instructions.md:
# HarborBoard Rules

## Rules
- `src/core/` must never import `src/http/`.
- Audit events are append-only; never mutate past entries.
files.README.md:
# HarborBoard

Internal release readiness and incident tracker.

## Storage
Uses PostgreSQL in production and SQLite locally (migrated from JSON files in v0.6).
files.docs/adr/0001-module-boundaries.md:
# ADR-0001: Core Boundary

## Decision
`src/core/` contains pure domain logic and must not depend on HTTP transport (`src/http/`).
files.docs/adr/0002-append-only-audit.md:
# ADR-0002: Immutable Audit Log

## Decision
Every freeze override appends one record carrying `requester` and `approver`; past records are never edited.
files.docs/adr/0003-soft-delete.md:
# ADR-0003: Retention by Tombstone Only

## Decision
Incidents are soft-deleted via `archivedAt` timestamps and never hard-deleted from storage.
files.docs/adr/0004-sla-threshold.md:
# ADR-0004: Freeze SLA Alerting

## Decision
Incidents unacknowledged past 15 minutes raise a high-priority escalation flag.
files.docs/runbooks/rollback.md:
# Rollback Runbook

## Steps
1. Freeze active deploys.
2. Revert to previous signed tag.
3. Verify `/readyz` returns `ready: true`.
